"""Read-only data-path wrapper for the exact frozen issue239 publication selection.

Reuses the prior235 digest/inspect definitions verbatim. Adds the already-used
native214 JSON-escaped inventory variants and ELF/Mach-O/checkpoint magic checks.
The wrapper changes selection/data paths; it is not an unchanged whole CLI.
"""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat

P=Path('/private/tmp/faction239-native-OWNED')
R=Path('/Users/cam/DEV/faction-bbs')
C=Path('/private/tmp/faction239-evidence-OWNED/assembly-candidate')
D=C/'dev-docs/evidence/menu-mail-notices'
K=R/'dev-docs/evidence/mail-correspondents/integration/scan_publication05.py'
K_SHA='2080fa293db227b866ecd11dfc9c1ac216070b32717a6c646030613994de8c06'
SELECTION_SHA='9c1c2b678c02fbdbb8372aefd9b31e72ac49e370c66004b20c98d504b63ea580'
DRAFT_SHA='946eac03137bf317a4a61f4fa2c8007359e02db1a93ce2f5c29f013627567ad5'

def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def exact_file(root,name):
    name=Path(name)
    assert not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts
    path=root/name
    assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())
    for p in [path,*path.parents]:
        if p==root.parent:break
        assert not p.is_symlink()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode)
    return path

def load_selected(root,manifest,expected):
    raw=manifest.read_bytes();assert sha(raw)==expected
    selected=json.loads(raw);assert isinstance(selected,dict) and selected
    result={}
    for name,wanted in selected.items():
        assert isinstance(wanted,str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',wanted)
        data=exact_file(root,name).read_bytes();assert sha(data)==wanted
        result[name]=data
    assert manifest.read_bytes()==raw
    return result

def findings(data,values):
    source=K.read_bytes();assert sha(source)==K_SHA
    text=source.decode();tree=ast.parse(text)
    definitions=[ast.get_source_segment(text,node) for node in tree.body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in {'digest','inspect'}]
    assert len(definitions)==2
    variants={v.encode() for v in values}|{json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=True)[1:-1].encode() for v in values}
    namespace=dict(hashlib=hashlib,re=re,seen=set(),matches=[],needles=list(variants))
    exec('\n\n'.join(definitions),namespace)
    namespace['inspect']('selected-bytes',data)
    matches=namespace['matches']
    return dict(generated_private_value=any(kind=='generated-private-value' for label,kind in matches),
        raw_private_key_or_vault=any(kind=='private-key-or-vault' for label,kind in matches) or data.startswith((b'FACTVLT',b'FACTCP',b'\x7fELF',b'\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe',b'\xfe\xed\xfa\xcf')))

def main():
    inventory=P/'private-inventory.json'
    reviewer=Path('/private/tmp/faction239-review-OWNED/private-capture-generated-values.json')
    expected={inventory:'3ce6de88d4a4d2dc7cb8cd5e802f1935041ca9930af1e6204e83d00514fe25f5',reviewer:'b87c2ffccc5ef727eba979c60a440c29d28c33d50956fca15b681cbd29be2203'}
    raw_inventory={}
    for path,h in expected.items():
        info=path.lstat();assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid==os.getuid() and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o600 and info.st_nlink==1
        raw_inventory[path]=path.read_bytes();assert sha(raw_inventory[path])==h
    native=json.loads(raw_inventory[inventory])['values'];extra=json.loads(raw_inventory[reviewer])['values']
    assert len(native)==len(set(native))==247 and len(extra)==42 and set(extra)<=set(native)
    values=sorted(set(native)|set(extra));assert len(values)==247
    # Actual retained private material is exercised in memory only, never output.
    simple=next(v for v in values if '\n' not in v and not v.startswith('-----'))
    assert findings(simple.encode(),values)['generated_private_value']
    escaped=next(v for v in values if '\n' in v or any(ord(c)>127 for c in v))
    assert findings(json.dumps(escaped,ensure_ascii=True)[1:-1].encode(),values)['generated_private_value']
    key=next(v for v in values if v.startswith('-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----'))
    assert all(findings(key.encode(),values).values())
    for magic in (b'FACTVLT1',b'FACTVLT2',b'FACTCP',b'\x7fELF',b'\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe',b'\xfe\xed\xfa\xcf'):
        assert findings(magic+b' public poison control',values)['raw_private_key_or_vault']
    assert not any(findings(b'public safe control; no member data',values).values())
    selection=D/'integration/candidate-manifest.json';draft=D/'results.draft.json'
    selected=load_selected(C,selection,SELECTION_SHA);assert len(selected)==429
    draft_bytes=draft.read_bytes();assert sha(draft_bytes)==DRAFT_SHA
    record=json.loads(draft_bytes);proofs={}
    for ref in record['sources']+record['prior_records']:
        root=C if (C/ref['path']).exists() else R
        path=exact_file(root,ref['path']);data=path.read_bytes();assert sha(data)==ref['sha256']
        proofs[str(path)]=data
    supplemental={str(draft):draft_bytes,str(selection):selection.read_bytes(),str(K):K.read_bytes()}
    test=P/'test_final_selection_scanner.py';self_path=Path(__file__).resolve()
    for path in [self_path,test,P/'logs/final-scan-interface-red.log',P/'logs/final-scan-contract-green.log']:
        supplemental[str(path)]=path.read_bytes()
    sources={**{'selected/'+name:data for name,data in selected.items()},**proofs,**supplemental}
    matches={k:[] for k in ['generated_private_value','raw_private_key_or_vault']}
    for name,data in sources.items():
        for kind,hit in findings(data,values).items():
            if hit:matches[kind].append(name)
    assert not any(matches.values()), 'private material detected; no values emitted'
    assert load_selected(C,selection,SELECTION_SHA)==selected and draft.read_bytes()==draft_bytes
    assert all(Path(name).read_bytes()==data for name,data in {**proofs,**supplemental}.items())
    assert all(path.read_bytes()==data for path,data in raw_inventory.items())
    result=dict(result='pass',scope='exact-frozen429-issue239-selection-draft-all-source-and-prior-proof-references',
        publication_selection_sha256=SELECTION_SHA,reviewed_draft_sha256=DRAFT_SHA,
        generated_private_values_scanned=len(values),private_inventory_sha256=expected[inventory],
        reviewer_inventory_sha256=expected[reviewer],reviewer_values_are_subset=True,
        private_matches=0,raw_private_key_or_vault_matches=0,explicit_manifests_verified=True,
        selected_payload_files=len(selected),source_and_prior_proof_paths=len(proofs),files_scanned=len(sources),
        source_and_file_set_unchanged=True,actual_generated_value_poison_rejected=True,
        actual_json_escaped_value_poison_rejected=True,actual_private_key_poison_rejected=True,
        vault_checkpoint_and_binary_poison_controls_rejected=True,safe_control_passed=True,
        reused_detection_kernel_sha256=K_SHA,native_detection_baseline_sha256='21440dde751570ef47657b1a488a0f2ff2f76dbc843a3ccdf7323c0c273f941f',
        scanner_wrapper_adaptation='Read-only explicit frozen selection/draft/source-reference data paths; verbatim prior235 digest/inspect plus existing native214 escaped variants and magic checks.',
        scanner_source_sha256=sha(self_path.read_bytes()),scanner_source_utf8=self_path.read_text(),
        scanner_tests_source_sha256=sha(test.read_bytes()),scanner_tests_source_utf8=test.read_text(),
        scanner_red_log_sha256=sha((P/'logs/final-scan-interface-red.log').read_bytes()),
        scanner_red_log_utf8=(P/'logs/final-scan-interface-red.log').read_text(),
        scanner_green_log_sha256=sha((P/'logs/final-scan-contract-green.log').read_bytes()),
        scanner_green_log_utf8=(P/'logs/final-scan-contract-green.log').read_text(),
        scanner_red_exit=1,scanner_green_exit=0,owned_roots_deleted_by_this_scan=False)
    data=(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode();assert not any(findings(data,values).values())
    out=P/'publication-scan-final.json';assert not out.exists();out.write_bytes(data);out.chmod(0o600)
    print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['result','publication_selection_sha256','reviewed_draft_sha256','generated_private_values_scanned','selected_payload_files','source_and_prior_proof_paths','files_scanned','private_matches','raw_private_key_or_vault_matches']}))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
import final_selection_scanner as scan

class FinalSelectionContracts(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_selected_bytes_and_manifest_hash_are_required(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=Path(__file__).parent) as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp);(root/'one.txt').write_bytes(b'public safe control')
            manifest=root/'selected.json';manifest.write_text(json.dumps({'one.txt':hashlib.sha256(b'public safe control').hexdigest()}))
            expected=hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            self.assertEqual(scan.load_selected(root,manifest,expected),{'one.txt':b'public safe control'})
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):scan.load_selected(root,manifest,'0'*64)
            (root/'one.txt').write_bytes(b'mutated source')
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):scan.load_selected(root,manifest,expected)
            manifest.write_text(json.dumps({'../escaped':'0'*64}))
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):scan.load_selected(root,manifest,hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            (root/'linked').symlink_to(root/'one.txt');manifest.write_text(json.dumps({'linked':hashlib.sha256(b'mutated source').hexdigest()}))
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):scan.load_selected(root,manifest,hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    def test_raw_json_escaped_private_key_vault_binary_and_safe_controls(self):
        values=['private-poison-λ\nvalue']
        for data in [values[0].encode(),json.dumps(values[0],ensure_ascii=True)[1:-1].encode()]:
            self.assertTrue(scan.findings(data,values)['generated_private_value'])
        for data in [b'-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\nsynthetic poison',b'-----BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----\nsynthetic poison']:
            self.assertTrue(scan.findings(data,values)['raw_private_key_or_vault'])
        for magic in [b'FACTVLT1',b'FACTVLT2',b'FACTCP',b'\x7fELF',b'\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe',b'\xfe\xed\xfa\xcf']:
            self.assertTrue(scan.findings(magic+b' poison',values)['raw_private_key_or_vault'])
        self.assertEqual(scan.findings(b'public safe control',values),dict(generated_private_value=False,raw_private_key_or_vault=False))

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
